name: Mahou Tou Shoujo Suzune
source:
Suzune fairly and squarely introduced herself as a heroine of justice.
On the other hand, the lead character is a talent-less and incapable of shooting her with a gun.
Then, he thought, "I may use my lust as a weapon?"
